protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

environment.machineLabel: MacBook Pro / Apple M1 Pro 8-core / 16 GiB / arm64

support.scope: Selected english_2026-04 checkpoint with eight bundled preset voices; not the broader multilingual family
support.notes: Alba, Azelma, Cosette, Eponine, Fantine, Javert, Jean and Marius are bundled; only alba in English is measured. This is the original approximately 100M Pocket family, not the newer 18.2M model. A pinned community ONNX/browser implementation is used.

cells.precision: Mixed: 4 quantized graphs (Flow main/flow, MIMI encoder/decoder); FP32 text conditioner.

settings.randomSeed: Unseeded; pinned worker uses Math.random() Box-Muller latent noise.
settings.frontend: Pinned KevinAHM Pocket TTS browser frontend: whitespace/newline normalization, optional semicolon cleanup, initial capitalization and terminal punctuation; pinned SentencePiece Unigram tokenizer, browser-loaded from a hash-locked local JSON conversion audited against the original tokenizer.model. Sentence splitting uses a 50-token internal limit. The 93 canonical spans are passed intact to the frontend.
settings.generation: One latent flow step, temperature 0.7 with unseeded Math.random noise, EOS logit threshold -4 and the pinned frontend frames-after-EOS rule; independent Flow/MIMI state is reset between internal utterances. Output is 24 kHz Float32 PCM with 0.25-second silence between internal utterances. A 500-frame guard is treated as an error, never silent truncation.
settings.voiceSelection: Pinned built-in English voice alba from the selected English bundle; the other seven bundled voices are not used in this configuration.
settings.modelFiles: Five pinned ONNX graphs; four use dynamically quantized initializers and the text conditioner is FP32. The local Unigram tokenizer conversion and preset voice-state assets are hash-locked.
settings.chunking: The 93 canonical source spans are passed whole; pinned frontend may split each into internal sentence/50-token utterances and inserts 0.25 seconds of silence between them.
settings.outputLocation: ONNX Runtime Web default CPU output; every session.run is awaited before copied Float32 PCM is returned.

capability.description: Observed 111434 WebGPU compute dispatches in separate untimed Pocket TTS synthesis; WebGPU with WASM fallback. Hooks removed before scored generation.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.

Screenshot campaign mach-pocket-2026-11-11-v1; cell order mach-boom/cpu, pocket-tts-100m-english-int8/webgpu, pocket-tts-100m-english-int8/cpu, mach-boom/webgpu; sequential headed Chrome on AC power. Other user apps left open; no controlled thermal stabilization or universal performance claim. Process-scoped idle-sleep prevention is active. No dedicated cold-load check. Separate single-article generation RSS diagnostic after warm campaign.

RSS is sampled every 500 ms across the owned Chrome process tree, including the Chrome baseline and inference workers. Whole-call peak spans post-timer validation/export; generation mean uses only in-window samples from browser generation start through final CPU-readable PCM.
